checks.claim: Exact event set and quadratic reconstruction.
checks.basis: An overlap branch switches only when t=a_j+k*tau or t=a_(j+1)+k*tau. Between these events its endpoints are affine in t, so the integral of affine g has degree at most two. Initial h is fixed on the open event cell. Three rational samples give C=p0, A=2(p0+p1-2pm), B=4pm-3p0-p1 exactly. Use actual right-continuous left endpoint and left-limit right endpoint.

checks.claim: Vertex split proves nonnegative Bernstein2 coefficients.
checks.basis: A quadratic derivative is affine and has at most one interior root. After exact vertex insertion each subcell is monotone. If increasing, B1=B0+D*P'(0)/2>=B0>=0. If decreasing, B1=B2-D*P'(D)/2>=B2>=0. This stronger argument is needed: polynomial nonnegativity alone would not prove coefficient nonnegativity.

The supremum equals the maximum of the monotone polynomial's endpoint/left-limit candidates; actual right endpoint has only a nonnegative initial term removed for 0<=q<=1. The upper is correct, but a left-limit value need not be attained. See R13-R6-F01.

Beta integrals give moment coefficients 1/[n!(n+3)], 2/[n!(n+2)(n+3)], 2/(n+3)! for i=0,1,2. Substitution x->1-x yields W_i(z,D)=exp(z)*W_(2-i)(-z,D). At z=0 all three moments are D/3; summing bases yields D*phi1(z).

For every moment, the beta coefficient decreases with n; thus after first omitted n=97 all successive ratios are bounded by |z|/98<1. First-omitted/(1-|z|/98) bounds the remaining nonnegative tail. The exp series uses the same ratio argument. Negative arguments require reciprocal endpoint reversal and swapped moment index. Actual rounding implementation remains a C9 obligation.

Nonnegative c and exact R supremum give forcing<=Qmax=c*Rsup+max(g_e endpoints). The positive scalar kernel compares E with constant-forcing Y. Y'=exp(d_c*u)(d_c*Eleft_upper+Qmax) has constant sign, so max(Y(0),Y(D)) is a closed-cell upper. This does not assert endpoint extremality for the true time-dependent E.

Overlap sums always start at original t0; source or observation subdivision changes a finite partition of the same integral. h>=0 and exp>=0 imply pointwise R/E order under g_affine<=g_sup. Rounded recurrence identity is not inferred from exact ideal identity.
